profile: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: YouTube channel profile image. Create a polished ORIGINAL pixel-art channel avatar for "Quase Infinito", using the supplied image solely as the visual reference for its recurring mascot Pico. Output a landscape 16:9 canvas, preferably exactly 2560x1440. The whole image must be 16:9. Deep midnight navy background, restrained teal and warm golden accents. CENTERED large close-up of Pico's head and upper torso, within a simple navy round emblem with one tasteful teal rim and a small golden orbit. Preserve the mascot's unmistakable design: golden explorer helmet, dark teal pilot goggles with bright aqua rectangular lenses, warm peach face, orange/coral flying scarf, turquoise suit, small pale-aqua wing shapes. Friendly confident curious expression, facing viewer. True crisp professional retro pixel art with square pixels, clean controlled silhouette and shading, modern brand polish. Keep all character and emblem within the central square region, with generous margin so a centered CIRCULAR crop does not clip the helmet, goggles or scarf. Optimize recognition at tiny avatar size: large face and goggles, simple shapes, very little detail. Fill the outside landscape area with the same seamless navy background. No text, letters, watermark, UI, labels, upload guides or collage. One finished image.

Beneath it, smaller gold text: "Cada pergunta abre outra viagem." approx y=785 to830. Keep text well centered, no warping or decorative glyph substitutions. Title and tagline and mascot must remain readable in a tight center horizontal mobile crop. Style tasteful cinematic pixel-art brand, mature and curious, clean composition, high contrast where important, understated elsewhere. No extra words, random lettering, logos, watermark or crop guides. One image only.
